full_judgment: 6. Be that as it may, the petitioner can still move the Labour Court against the ex-parte order in the present case under Order 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with sub-section (2) of section 36 of I.R.O. by 13th September, 1980 at the latest. The period between the passing of the ex-parte order till the filing of the application for setting aside of such ex-parte order shall be computed under section 14 of the Limitation Act.
